# RouteLocation v1.2.25

## 繁體中文
- 地圖「選點／加航點」只決定點擊操作，手動切換保留路線草稿；明確清除草稿會回到選點。
- 草稿徽章可返回編輯，Quick／Classic 共用安全的清除行為，不停止單點模擬。
- 草稿、預覽和播放卡加入可展開的起終點時區資訊，封閉路線明確表示返回起點。
- 路線列表播放入口使用既有切換確認；修正首次從預覽開啟編輯器與 live speed 草稿誤判。
- 教學聚焦真正的地點／路線操作列，修正 S2 中文縮放提示。

## English
- Select / Add Points controls map taps only. Switching preserves drafts; explicitly clearing a draft returns to Select.
- The draft badge returns to editing. Quick and Classic share safe clearing without stopping single-point simulation.
- Draft, preview, and playback cards offer expandable endpoint time zones, local time, and baseline comparisons. Closed routes clearly return to their start.
- Route-list playback uses the existing switch confirmation. Fixed first-use preview editing and live-speed changes being treated as draft edits.
- Tutorials highlight the actual saved place/route controls. Corrected the Chinese S2 zoom hint.

Re-sign with SideStore, AltStore, TrollStore, or a compatible tool.
